name: HASAN ALSALAMI
title: IT & Business Manager | Project Leader | AI & Cloud Solutions Expert
tagline: Driving digital transformation through AI, cloud technologies, and business innovation.
bio:
Hasan Alsalami is an experienced IT and Business Manager with a strong background in enterprise technology, cloud infrastructure, artificial intelligence, and business process automation.

He leads technology and transformation initiatives that improve operational efficiency, reduce costs, and create scalable digital solutions. His expertise includes project management, Microsoft 365, Azure, cybersecurity, data analytics, and custom software development.

Hasan is passionate about combining business strategy with cutting-edge technologies such as AI, machine learning, and cloud computing to deliver measurable results and long-term growth.
